item.title: 'Cyberpunk: Edgerunners' Season 3 Confirmed? Potential Release Date, Characters, and Everything You Need to Know
item.description: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 ends with something almost surprising for this franchise: some characters looking forward to tomorrow. Without spoiling too much, the season 2 finale delivers plenty of devastating TV moments, like season 1, but several of its central characters survive with relationships worth holding onto and lives they still want to live. Naturally, that makes another more direct follow-up that much more enticing.

item.title: Critical Role Is Heading to Middle-earth With a Big Lord of the Rings Collaboration
item.description: As much as we all love Critical Role ’s long, multi-episode adventures, the cast has also delivered plenty of Dungeons & Dragons and Daggerheart one-shots. While some have proven controversial (who can forget the Wendy collaboration?), several sponsored one-shots have also been incredibly fun to watch, like Control: Resonant and even Suikoden .

item.title: 7 Funniest 'Calvin and Hobbes' Comics About Calvin's Mom and Dad
item.description: Calvin’s Mom and Dad, who have no names beyond that, each have their own individual dynamic with Calvin. Calvin’s Mom is often exasperated with him, as she’s the one who does the most direct parenting in her role as a homemaker. This leads to a lot of funny comic strips where Calvin drives his mom nuts. As for Calvin’s Dad , while Calvin drives him bonkers too, there’s another dynamic where the dad will sometimes tell Calvin ridiculous things just to see if his son will believe them, which he often does.

item.title: Cyberpunk 2077 Edgerunners 2 Update Leaked Ahead of Reveal
item.description: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Season 2 premiered this week on Netflix. To celebrate a new season of the award-winning anime, CD Projekt Red cooked up another major update for Cyberpunk 2077 , likely to entice players to return to Night City for one more playthrough. Though the update isn't live yet, its contents have been leaked ahead of release.

item.title: 17 Years Later, Johnny Depp’s Overlooked Action Crime Thriller Is Officially Free on YouTube
item.description: Based on Bryan Burrough’s nonfiction book of the same name, Michael Mann’s Public Enemies puts Depp in the shoes of John Dillinger, one of the most prolific bank robbers in American history, set during his final few months of thieving in 1934. As he wreaks havoc across the Midwest, Dillenger attempts to stay one step ahead of Melvin Purvis (Christian Bale), a ruthless federal agent tasked with finally bringing him justice. With a proven track record of bringing crime epics to life, from Miami Vice to Heat , Mann captures a transformative moment when the relationship between criminals, the public, and the authorities was rapidly shifting. Dillinger became a symbol of defiance during the Great Depression, when banks were the furthest thing from beloved institutions, while the newly empowered FBI was working to establish itself as a formidable national force. The film’s historical scope is narrower than Burrough’s sprawling account of America’s crime wave, but that focus gives Mann room to explore the mythology surrounding one particularly charismatic outlaw.

item.title: All 'Stranded' keypad puzzle codes in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: There are eight keypad puzzle codes to solve during "Stranded" in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 , but figuring out the number puzzles isn't easy. Inside each one, you'll find valuable supplies and equipment that will help you take down the three mandatory objectives, so it's worth exploring the entirety of this open-world section before tackling the bunker, jamming station, and SAM site.

item.title: Marvel Officially Made the Saddest Death in MCU History More Tragic With Just 1 Sentence
item.description: In Avengers: Infinity War , when Dr. Strange (Benedict Cumberbatch) and a variety of other heroes are awaiting Thanos’ arrival on Titan, Strange uses the Time Stone to look into alternate futures to see the possible results of the impending conflict. Star Lord (Chris Pratt) asks Strange how many futures he looked into, and Strange replies, “14,000,605.” Then Iron Man (Robert Downey Jr.) asks how many of those resulted in their victory. Strange, looking deep into Stark’s eyes, says, “One.”

item.title: 'VisionQuest' Episode 4 Ending Explained: Who Is Jocasta?
item.description: While the first two episodes of VisionQuest focus on Vision (Paul Bettany) being pursued by the bounty hunter Paladin (Todd Stashwick), the two episodes released on Oct. 20 introduce a new threat. Both Paladin and Vision cross paths with another synthezoid who has deep roots in Marvel Comics , though the show has given the character a very different backstory and motivation. If you’re looking for answers after episode 4’s cliffhanger, here’s what we know about Jocasta (T'Nia Miller) and what she’s up to.

item.title: Forget ‘Carrie,’ Mike Flanagan’s Best Netflix Miniseries Is a Masterpiece From Start to Finish
item.description: Long before he was at the helm of the Prime Video adaptation of Stephen King's Carrie, Mike Flanagan made waves for himself with his trilogy of Netflix TV miniseries . His ability to helm works that combine horror and genuine human exploration. Recently, The Fall of the House of Usher reimagined classic Edgar Allan Poe tales to terrifying success, with each episode adapting a different story.
